subject: general
question:
For an electric generator, which of the following statement(s) are true:

(i) Induced current can be increased by increasing the number of turns in the coil

(ii) Induced current can be increased by increasing the speed of the coil

(iii) Induced current can be increased by decreasing the applied magnetic field
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both (i) and (ii)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An electric generator is a device that is used to convert mechanical energy into electric energy.
 
• It is also known as a dynamo.
 
• An electric generator works on the Electromagnetic Induction Principle.
 
• The Principle of Electromagnetic Induction states that when a conductor connected with a changing flux, it will induce an emf across it. The value of induced emf across the conductor depends on the rate of change of flux connected with the conductor.
